title: FPL Squad Planner
tagline: A real pitch-based squad planner with formations, captaincy, live team lookup, fixtures, and injury news
highlights: Redesigned from a flat squad-list utility into a pitch-based decision workspace — 7 legal formations, click-to-set captain/vice, live gameweek deadline countdown — while keeping the existing scheduled-Action + serverless-proxy data architecture unchanged

Received a detailed redesign brief modeled on professional FPL tools (projected points, xG, ownership trends, captaincy AI); implemented the phases with real, verifiable data and explicitly deferred the phases that would require presenting invented statistics as fact
Every interaction gives feedback (toast confirmations for adds, captaincy, formation changes) per the brief's own interaction-design requirement
